name: Dynamic Projection Mapping for Rotating Volumetric Display
aliases: Handheld Volumetric Display Using Dynamic Projection Mapping
definition: A method for displaying layered volumetric images by projecting specific optical patterns onto the surface of a rotating object composed of fan-shaped disks, using external high-speed cameras for tracking and a high-speed projector for rendering, allowing users to freely move and rotate the object.
summary: Dynamic Projection Mapping renders layered volumetric images on manually rotating fan-shaped disks using external tracking, providing discrete physical depth planes unlike spiral swept-volume approaches.
